aboutGame.title: What is Village in the Shade?
paragraphs: Village in the Shade is a hand-painted single-player farming and life simulation from Nippon Ichi Software, published in the West by NIS America. Set in Kagatsu, a secluded Japanese mountain village, it combines seasonal crops, livestock, fishing, hunting, cooking, crafting, festivals, and villager relationships with a code of eight unsettling rules.

By day you restore a neglected home and farm and build a routine around the people of Kagatsu. After 11 PM, the standard experience opens the mystery path through rule-breaking, night exploration, ghosts, Magatama, Lost Books, and other supernatural encounters. Peaceful Life Mode, also called Village in the Sunshine, keeps the farming loop while closing off rule-breaking and the darker story route.

modules.name: Village in the Shade Beginner Guide
modules.description: Start with a practical first week: learn the map, clear the overgrown plot, establish reliable income, upgrade daily tools, and build a routine that ends before the 11 PM curfew.

highlights.detail: Scout Kagatsu in daylight and mark shops, fields, fishing spots, and village exits.
Clear and plant the starting plot, keeping about a third of your seeds in reserve.
Upgrade watering and tilling tools before buying decorations or expanding fields.
Cook surplus ingredients and sell prepared dishes for stronger early income.
Finish farm chores before evening and scout a safe route home before testing curfew.

modules.name: Village in the Shade Farming Guide
modules.description: Manage fields, ridges, and rice paddies across the seasons, improve crop quality, and build a daily routine that supports cooking, crafting, livestock, and villager requests.

highlights.label: Fields
highlights.detail: Open-ground plots are the cheapest first crop surface to clear, plant, and expand.

highlights.label: Ridges
highlights.detail: Raised rows suit specific crops and become useful after the first harvest cycle.

highlights.label: Paddies
highlights.detail: Dedicated rice cultivation needs water access and planning around the season.

highlights.label: Quality
highlights.detail: Fertilizer, scarecrows, and tool upgrades raise produce value over repeated harvests.

highlights.label: Support
highlights.detail: Cooking, crafting, livestock, fishing, and hunting smooth out income between crops.

modules.name: Village in the Shade Village Rules and Nighttime Guide
modules.description: Learn the eight rules of Kagatsu, the 11 PM curfew, the Autumn story gates, and the Winter Gold Axe route, then prepare for the ghosts, Magatama, and Lost Books found after dark.

highlights.label: Curfew
highlights.detail: The 11 PM rule sends you home unless a special night event opens access.

highlights.label: Autumn
highlights.detail: Rules Five and Six mark the Autumn turning point and the mountain voice.

highlights.label: Gold Axe
highlights.detail: Rule Seven's Winter route needs a Gold Axe to clear fallen thicket trees.

highlights.label: Night
highlights.detail: Night events lead to ghosts, Magatama, Lost Books, and mystery progression.

modules.name: Village in the Shade Characters and Gifts Guide

highlights.label: Rin
highlights.detail: Village head; check with her when a request, unlock, or story step stalls.

highlights.label: Komako
highlights.detail: First villager you meet; archery teacher linked to hunting and combat.

highlights.label: Sazanka
highlights.detail: Runs the general store for seeds, supplies, and everyday essentials.

highlights.label: Hasumi
highlights.detail: Village physician; the person to visit after a rough hunting trip.

modules.name: Village in the Shade Money Making Guide
modules.description: Compare the village's main income routes, from seasonal crops and livestock to fishing, foraging, and licensed hunting, and learn where to reinvest early profits.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Farming: seasonal crops, livestock products, and cooked dishes form the most reliable daily income loop.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Fishing: catches depend on season, time, and location and help cover slow weeks between harvests.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Foraging: free route materials support crafting, cooking, and tool upgrades without seed costs.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Hunting: a license opens afternoon trips for meat and animal materials with high-value sales.

modules.name: Village in the Shade Fishing and Hunting Guide
modules.description: Learn how fishing and hunting fit into the daily economy, what gear and licenses they require, and how their ingredients support cooking, crafting, gifts, and villager requests.

highlights.label: Fishing
highlights.detail: Match season, time, and location; catches feed cooking, selling, and collection goals.

highlights.label: Hunting
highlights.detail: Unlock a hunting license early for meat, animal materials, and high-value sales.

highlights.label: License
highlights.detail: The license also opens gathering routes and afternoon trips outside the farm.

highlights.label: Cooking
highlights.detail: Turn fish and meat into dishes worth more than the raw ingredients.

highlights.label: Peaceful

highlights.label: New Save

highlights.label: Shared

faq.title: Village in the Shade FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers about Village in the Shade, its farming loop, village rules, game modes, platforms, and nighttime mystery.

items.question: What is Village in the Shade?
items.answer: Village in the Shade is a single-player farming and life simulation from Nippon Ichi Software, published in the West by NIS America. It is set in Kagatsu, a Japanese mountain village where crops, livestock, fishing, hunting, cooking, crafting, festivals, and relationships share the same world as a supernatural village code.

items.question: Is Village in the Shade a farming game or a horror game?
items.answer: It is both. The daytime loop is a full farming and life simulation, while the standard experience adds folk horror, psychological tension, rule-breaking, and nighttime encounters after the 11 PM curfew.

items.question: What happens after the 11 PM curfew in Village in the Shade?
items.answer: In the standard experience, the 11 PM curfew sends you home during ordinary nights. Special night events let you explore after curfew, opening the path to ghosts, Magatama, Lost Books, and the mystery-driven main story.

items.question: Can I play Village in the Shade without the horror?
items.answer: Yes. Choose Peaceful Life Mode, often called Village in the Sunshine, when starting a new file. It blocks rule-breaking and closes the darker story route while keeping farming, livestock, fishing, hunting, and villager relationships.

items.question: Which platforms is Village in the Shade available on?
items.answer: Village in the Shade is available on PC through Steam, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2. The PC version adds Japanese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean text to the English, French, and Spanish console languages.

items.question: How many villagers are in Village in the Shade?
items.answer: Kagatsu has 14 named residents plus a customizable player character. The cast includes Rin, Komako, Sazanka, Rokkaku, Hasumi, Chinana, Shiroji, Konno, Sumire, and Yoh.
